decisions.reason: The firm presented the anamnesis app publicly as its new flagship product line, invested in several models, and tied it to its announced digital direction, so dropping it would write off a visible investment and expose the strategic choice as a mistake.

The education institute builds on the firm's established training resources and supports customer loyalty at modest cost, and one year is too early to blame weak results on anything but start-up effects.

The remote screen sharing tool is a low-cost add-on that is integral to the firm's support offering, so although little has been invested or publicly committed, it serves the core business and offers little reason to drop it.
